question: What equal measure is prescribed from the navel to the limit of the yoni?
premises: The starting point is the navel.
The endpoint is the limit of the yoni.
The prescribed measure is thirteen aṅgulas.
inference: The distance from the navel to the yoni limit is thirteen aṅgulas.
plain_english: From the navel to the limit of the yoni, the measure is equally thirteen aṅgulas.
